releaseNotes:
• Official Release v1.1.9 (Build 20)
• Complete Cloudflare R2 Media Storage Migration (Photos, Videos, Voice Notes, Documents)
• Live Firestore Chat Document Authorization with multi-participant verification
• Strict Bearer Token Security with zero URL token leakage
• WebRTC Voice & Video Calling with resilient reconnect and late SDP buffering
• Persistent WorkManager Outbox Retry Engine with crash recovery
• Background Push Notifications & Multi-Device FCM Isolation
